n-k-k4-01.title: Ogeysiiska la soo koobay
n-k-k4-01.goal: Isbarbar dhig soo koobid gaaban ee fasal-wadaage iyo ogeysiiska maktabadda, hel sadarrada beddela waxa ogeysiisku sheego, oo hal ka mid ah sax.
n-k-k4-01.material:
Fasal-wadaage cusub ayaa weydiiyay 현우 xeerarka maktabadda dugsiga. 현우 wuxuu akhriyaa ogeysiiska hoose wuxuuna u qoraa soo koobid gaaban.

[도서관 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 평일 오전 9시~오후 5시 / 토요일 오전 9시~낮 12시 / 일요일은 쉽니다.
- 책은 한 번에 5권까지, 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
- 늦게 반납하면 늦은 날 수만큼 책을 빌릴 수 없어요.
- 음료는 뚜껑이 있는 물병만 가지고 들어갈 수 있어요.
n-k-k4-01.thinking.0: Soo koobid aan wax ka dhigin
n-k-k4-01.thinking.1: Isbarbar dhigidda koobi iyo isha sadar-sadar
n-k-k4-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 평일, 토요일, 일요일, 빌리다 iyo 돌려주다
n-k-k4-01.prereq.2: Wuxuu yaqaan 뚜껑 (daboolka) iyo 물병 (dhalada biyaha)
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.prompt: Soo koobidda 현우 ayaa hoose ku taal. Sadarro qaarkood waxay sheegaan wax ka duwan ogeysiiska. Dooro mid ka mid ah.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Soo koobidda sadar-sadar u soco oo hel sadarka u dhigma ee ogeysiiska.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sadar kasta weydii: ma ogeysiisku si sax ah buu u sheegayaa tan, mise soo koobiddu waxay beddeshay maalin, muddo ama shuruud?
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.2: Hubi sadarrada ka kooban maalin, tiro maalmood ama erayga 'wax kasta'.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.explain: Sadarrada 2, 5 iyo 6 waa khalad. Ogeysiisku wuxuu leeyahay 일요일은 쉽니다 (Axadda waa xidhan), mamnuucidda amaahdu waxay jirtaa intii maalmood ee buuggu daahay oo keliya, dhalada biyaha ee daboolka leh oo keliya ayaa la oggol yahay. Sadarrada 1, 3 iyo 4 waxay waafaqsan yihiin ogeysiiska.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.prompt: Sadarka ugu dambeeya ee soo koobiddu wuu gaaban yahay oo saaxiibtinimo leh. Maxay fasal-wadaagga cusub dhib ugu tahay?
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sadarka 6 dhig sadarka ugu dambeeya ee ogeysiiska agtiisa.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hel ereyga yar ee ogeysiiska ku jira ee xadidaya cabitaannada la oggol yahay, oo arag haddii soo koobidda ilaalisay.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.a: Waxay u malayn doontaa inaysan keeni karin cabbitaan gabi ahaanba.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.a: Soo koobiddu ma diidayso cabitaannada; waxay oggolaatay cabitaan kasta, taasoo ah khalad lid ah.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.b: Waxay u malayn doontaa in cabitaanku la oggol yahay maalmaha shaqada oo keliya.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.b: Soo koobiddu waxba ka sheegto maalmaha cabitaannada. Dhibku waa shuruud maqan oo ku saabsan cabitaanka.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.c: Waxay keeni kartaa cabitaan aan la oggolayn, sababtoo ah shuruud ayaa laga tegay.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.d: Waxay u malayn doontaa in maktabaddu ogolaato inay keento cunto iyo cabitaanba.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.d: Sadarku wuxuu ku saabsan yahay cabitaannada oo keliya; cuntada kuma sheegna.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.explain: Soo koobid waxay khalad noqon kartaa iyadoo aan hal eray oo khaldan lahayn: 아무거나 wuxuu meesha ka saaray shuruudda (뚜껑이 있는 물병만). Shuruudaha la dhaafo waa hab caadi ah oo xeer loo beddelo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor sadarka cabitaanka (sadarka ugu dambeeya ee soo koobidda) Kuuriyaan si uu u sheego isla waxa ogeysiisku sheego. Isticmaal hadal edeb leh oo -요 ah.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ku noqo sadarka ugu dambeeya ee ogeysiiska oo hel cabitaannada la oggol yahay.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.1: Shuruuddee ayuu sadarka soo koobidda lumiyay? Dib u dhig.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sadarkayga wuxuu ilaaliyaa daboolka iyo dhalada biyaha labadaba?
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma arday cusub oo sadarkayga keliya akhriyaa wuxuu keeni lahaa wixii saxda ah?
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Wuxuu si dhow u koobiyeeyaa shuruudda.

n-k-k4-02.title: Keega bilaashka ah dhalashada?
n-k-k4-02.goal: Isku dar war-saaraha iyo qoraalka saaxiibka, ogow xaqiiqooyinka go'aamiya haddii qorshuhu shaqeynayo, oo saaxiibkaa u sheeg waxa uu sameeyo.
n-k-k4-02.material:
Maanta waa 수요일. Saaxiibkaa 하나 wuxuu ku diray qoraal, wuxuuna sidoo kale ku siiyay war-saaraha makhaayadda.

[카페 봄날 생일 이벤트]
- 생일인 손님은 케이크 한 조각이 무료예요.
- 생일 3일 전까지 전화로 예약해 주세요. (예: 생일이 금요일이면 화요일까지)
- 일요일은 이벤트를 하지 않아요.
- 신분증을 가지고 오세요.

하나의 문자: "내 생일이 이번 주 토요일이야! 카페 봄날에서 무료 케이크 먹자. 예약은 나중에 할게."
n-k-k4-02.thinking.2: Ogaanshaha waqtiga ugu dambeeya ee ku qarsoon war-saaraha
n-k-k4-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan maalmaha usbuucyada, 전화, 예약
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.prompt: Labada macluumaad ee kee ayaa go'aamiya haddii qorshaha 하나 shaqeynayo? Dooro labadaba.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Xaqiiqooyinkee, marka la wada qaado, ayaa kuu siinaya taariikh?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Xaqiiqo kasta hubi: ma ka dhigi kartaa qorshaha inuu fashilmo kahor intaan 하나 gaarin makhaayadda?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.b: Dhalashada 하나 waa Sabti, sidaa darteed xeerka Axadda qorshahan muhiim kuma aha.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.d: Tan waa in laga sameeyo makhaayadda, laakiin ma go'aamiso haddii qorshaha weli shaqayn karo.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.e: Tani waa sababta qorshaha, ma aha xeer aad hubineyso.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.explain: Xeerka ballanta iyo maalinta dhalashada waa in la wada geliyo: dhalasho Sabti ah oo lagu daro 'ilaa 3 maalmood kahor' waxay bixisaa waqti kama dambays ah, wuxuuna noqon karaa mid dhow.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.prompt: Ku dabaq tusaalaha war-saaraha. Maanta waa 수요일. Dhalasho Sabti ah, maalinta ugu dambaysa ee ballan la samaysto waa kee?
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Isticmaal tusaalaha war-saaraha sida qaab: dhalashada ka bilow, oo tiri isla tirada maalmood dib ugu soco.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qor maalmaha si kala horreyn Sabti, Jimce, Khamiis, ... oo ku joogso tirada saxda ah.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.a: Khamiisku wuxuu kahor yahay Sabtida 2 maalmood oo keliya, sidaa darteed hadda aad buu u daahay.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.c: Salaasadu waxay kahor tahay Sabtida 4 maalmood. Ku tiri tusaalaha: dhalasho Jimce ah waxay siisaa Salaasada.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.d: Isniintu waxay kahor tahay Sabtida 5 maalmood; tusaalaha war-saaraha (dhalasho Jimce ah, Salaasa) wuxuu muujinayaa 3 maalmood kahor.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.explain: Jimce ilaa Salaasa waa 3 maalmood kahor, sidaa darteed Sabti ilaa Arbaco waa isla masaafo. Maanta waa Arbaco, sidaa darteed maanta waa maalinta ugu dambaysa.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.prompt: Qor qoraal gaaban oo loogu talagalay 하나 Kuuriyaan (hadal saaxiibtinimo leh oo -요 ah). U sheeg waxa ay samayso iyo ilaa goorma, iyo sababta.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ku bilow maalinta: goorma ayay tahay inay ficil gasho?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.1: Dheh waxa ay tahay inay sameyso (maxay, sidee) oo ku dar sababta -아서/-어서 ama -니까.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qoraalkaygu wuxuu sheegayaa maanta, waxa la sameeyo iyo sababta?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma 하나 wuu ogaan lahaa waxa uu sameeyo kadib markii uu akhriyo?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.modelNote.0: Wuxuu magacaabaa maanta, wicitaanka iyo sababta.

n-k-k4-03.title: Tigidhada kooxda
n-k-k4-03.goal: U beddel fariinta saaxiib oo leh xeer saamiga qarsoon shuruudo sax ah, dhis kooxo badan oo ku habboon, oo ka warbixi mid Kuuriyaan.
n-k-k4-03.material:
Saaxiibkaa 서연 wuxuu kuu qoraa kahor intaadan iibsan tigidhada beerta madadaalada:

"놀이공원에 같이 가요. 어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요. 어린이도 한 명은 가야 해요. 모두 5명 이상 가고 싶어요. 표값은 모두 합쳐서 6만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요."

(1만 원 = 10,000원, sidaa darteed 6만 원 = 60,000원. Kooxdu waa dadka waaweyn iyo carruurta aad taxdo oo keliya.)

[표값]
어른 한 명: 10,000원
어린이 한 명: 6,000원
n-k-k4-03.thinking.0: Akhrinta xeer isku xidha laba lambar
n-k-k4-03.thinking.2: Helista in ka badan hal xal
n-k-k4-03.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan tirooyinka, 명, 어른, 어린이 iyo -까지
n-k-k4-03.prereq.2: Wuu yaqaan 만 (10,000) qiimaha sida 3만 8천 원
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.prompt: Maxay kuu sheegtaa '어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요'?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore ku tijaabi xeerka hal qof weyn: intee carruur ah ayaa imaan kara?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kadibna tijaabi laba qof oo waaweyn oo arag sida tirada u koraysay.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.a: Hal qof weyn wuxuu qaadi karaa ilaa laba carruur.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.b: Qof weyn kasta waa inuu qaato laba carruur oo sax ah.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.b: '까지' wuxuu bixiyaa xad sare, ma aha tiro loo baahan yahay.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.c: Carruurtu waxay noqon karaan sida dadka waaweyn oo kale.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.c: Xeerku wuxuu leeyahay laba carruur qof weyn kasta, ma aha mid.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.d: Ilmo kasta wuxuu u baahan yahay laba qof oo waaweyn oo la socda.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.d: Tani waxay rogaysaa xeerka: halkan hal qof weyn wuxuu qaadi karaa laba carruur.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.explain: '-까지' wuxuu dejiyaa xad: hal qof weyn wuxuu qaadaa ilaa laba carruur, sidaa darteed 2 qof oo waaweyn waxay qaadi karaan ugu badnaan 4 carruur.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka hel 3 koox oo ku habboon shuruud kasta oo fariinta ku jirta, mid kasta tiro kala duwan oo dad waaweyn leh. a = dad waaweyn, c = carruur.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor shuruudaha erayadaaga, hal khad mid kasta.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ku bilow a = 2 oo raadi tirooyinka carruurta ee qancinaya xeerka carruurta iyo xeerka 5-ta qof.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.2: Lacagta ugu dambayn hubi: 10,000 × a + 6,000 × c.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Ugu yaraan hal qof weyn iyo hal ilmo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Waxaad u baahan tahay ugu yaraan hal qof weyn, fariintuna waxay leedahay ugu yaraan hal ilmo (어린이도 한 명은).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Laba carruur ka badan qof weyn kasta ma jiraan.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Carruur aad u badan: qof weyn kasta wuxuu qaadi karaa ilaa laba (어린이 두 명까지).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Fariintu waxay rabtaa 5 qof ama ka badan (모두 5명 이상).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Tigidhadu waxay ku kacaan in ka badan 60,000 won.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.explain: Tusaale ahaan 2 qof oo waaweyn + 3 carruur = 38,000 won; 3 + 3 = 48,000 won; 4 + 2 = 52,000 won. Kooxo badan ayaa ku habboon sababtoo ah fariintu waxay bixisaa xaddidaadyo, ma aha hal koox oo sax ah.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro HAL ka mid ah kooxahaaga oo u dir 서연 qoraal gaaban oo Kuuriyaan ah (edeb leh -요): marka hore dadka waaweyn, kadibna carruurta, kadibna qiimaha guud. Qor tirooyinka sida ciffado ama erayada tirooyinka Kuuriyaanka.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isticmaal hal koox oo kor ah: labada tiro maxay yihiin?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sheeg dadka waaweyn, kadibna carruurta, kadibna wadarta won.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma tirooyinka qoraalkayga waxay la mid yihiin hal koox oo aan dhisay?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma wadartu waa 10,000 × dad waaweyn + 6,000 × carruur?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.prompt: Ina adeerka 서연 wuxuu soo jeediyaa: '어른 5명이랑 어린이 2명이 가요. 모두 7명이고 5만 8천 원이에요.' Shuruudee ayay qorshahani jebinayaa?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ku tijaabi qorshaha shuruud kasta oo fariinta ku jirta, mid mid.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.1: Xisaab kasta adigu samee; ha ku tiirin tirooyinka qorshaha ku qoran.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.a: Carruur ka badan inta xeerku oggolaado ayaa jira.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.a: Shan qof oo waaweyn waxay qaadi karaan ilaa toban carruur, qorshuhuna wuxuu leeyahay laba oo keliya.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.b: Wax ka yar 5 qof ayaa tegaya.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.b: 7 qof ayaa jira, sidaa darteed xeerka 5-ta qof waa la buuxiyay.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.c: Qorshuhu wuxuu leeyahay 2 carruur, sidaa darteed xeerka ugu yaraan hal ilmo waa la buuxiyay.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.d: Tigidhadu runtii waxay ku kacaan 62,000 won, taas oo ka badan xadka.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.explain: Shan qof oo waaweyn waxay ku kacaan 50,000 won iyo laba carruur 12,000 won, taas oo ah 62,000 won, ka badan 60,000. Tirada qorshaha ku jirtay waxay ahayd khalad. Mar walba dib u xisaabi wadarta adigu halkii aad koobi lahayd.

n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aami adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad ilaa hadda akhrisay oo keliya.
n-k-k4-04.title: Bixinta cuntada fudud
n-k-k4-04.goal: Akhri wada hadal gaaban marxalado, beddel akhrintaada marka weedho cusub yimaadaan, kadibna jawaab si aan qofna u qiyaasin.
n-k-k4-04.material: Waxaad ku jirtaa makhaayadda dugsiga oo aad la joogtaa fasal-wadaagaaga 지우. Waxaad soo saartaa bac buskud ah.
n-k-k4-04.thinking.2: Qorista jawaab aan si khaldan loo akhrin karin
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta, dooro akhrinta u muuqata inay ugu macquulsan tahay, kadibna sii wad.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Raadi erayada bixiya sabab ama waqti jawaabta koowaad ka dib.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxay 지우 inta badan ula jeedaa?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Labada akhris labaduba waa suurtagal: 괜찮아요 waxay aqbali kartaa ama diidi kartaa bixin. Hal jawaab gaaban ma ku filna.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Way jeceshahay in ay hesho buskud.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Waxay rabtaa cunto fudud oo kale halkii.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxba ma sheegayaan cunto fudud oo kale; kaliya waxay ka jawaabaysaa bixintaada.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Jawaabteedu waa gaaban oo edeb leh, ma aha su'aal.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda maxay 지우 inta badan ula jeedaa?
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.after: '-아서요' wuxuu bixiyaa sababta. Cunista wax badan qadada waxay ka dhigaysaa 'mahadsanid maya' akhrinta ka wanaagsan.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Way jeceshahay in ay hesho buskud, sababtoo ah waxay cuntay wax badan qadada.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Qado weyn waa sabab aan loo cunin wax dheeraad ah, sidaa darteed waxay tilmaamaysaa diidmo.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Si edeb leh ayay maya u leedahay, sababtoo ah way dhergeen.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Waxay rabtaa cunto fudud oo kale.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ma sheegto cunto fudud oo kale.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Waxay ku jawaabtaa sabab la xiriirta cunista, sidaa darteed way maqashay.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Hadda sawirka oo dhan waa cad yahay: maya hadda, laga yaabo haa dambe. 괜찮아요 kii ugu horreeyay keligiis ma muujin karin taas.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hadda maya, laakiin laga yaabo hal buskud dambe.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxay weydiisanaysaa mid dambe, sidaa darteed ma diido weligeed.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxay tidhi 이따가 (dambe), ma aha hadda.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Waxay rabtaa inaad buskudka meel iska dhigto.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waxay kaa weydiisanaysaa mid dambe, sidaa darteed waxay rabtaa inaad haysato.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.reflect: 괜찮아요 wuxuu ula jeedi karaa 'haa, waa fiican yahay' ama 'mahadsanid maya'. Erayada ka dambeeya (sabab, waqti) ayaa go'aamiya midka. Jawaab edeb leh weli waa mid aan cad ahayn.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.prompt: Saaxiibkaa 민호 wuxuu ku siinayaa cunto fudud. Jawaabtee ayaa 민호 si sahlan u fahmi karaa si khaldan?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Mid kasta weydii: ka dib akhrintiisa, ma 민호 wuu ogaan lahaa inuu hadda cuntada ku siiyo?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qiyaas jawaab kasta fariin qoraal ah oo aan lahayn codka: ma 민호 ayaa akhrin kara laba hab oo is dhaafsan?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.r.a: Tani si cad ayay hadda u diidaysaa.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.r.b: Tani si cad ayay u aqbalaysaa.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.r.d: Tani si cad ayay u tidhaahdaa 'dambe'.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.explain: 괜찮아요 keliya waxaa loo maqli karaa haa ama maya. Diidmo ama aqbalaad leh eray cad (안 먹을게요, 주세요) lama fahmi karo si khaldan.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.prompt: 민호 wuxuu ku siinayaa cunto fudud. Hadda ma rabto, laakiin dambe laga yaabaa inaad rabto. Ku jawaab af Kuuriyaan (hadal edeb leh -요) si 민호 u fahmi waayo si khaldan.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.0: Si cad u dheh hadda ma cuni doontid oo sii sabab gaaban.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ku dar hal weedh oo kale oo ku saabsan waxa laga yaabo inaad dambe sameyso.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma 민호 wuu ogaan lahaa inaan hadda maya dhahay?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma 민호 wuu ogaan lahaa inaan dambe haa dhihi karo?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.modelNote.0: Hadda wuu diidayaa, sabab ayuu bixiyaa, dambe ayuu weydiisanayaa.

n-k-k4-05.title: Guriga goor dambe: hal qorshe, laba akhriste
n-k-k4-05.goal: U sheeg isla war ayeeyadaa iyo walaalkaa yar, adigoo beddelaya heerka hadalka Kuuriyaanka mid walba.
n-k-k4-05.material: Maanta waxaad leedahay layliga kooxda oo guriga waxaad joogi doontaa 7:00, ka dambeeya caadada. Waxaad u dhigi doontaa qoraal ayeeyadaa (할머니), iyo fariin walaalkaa yar (동생), kaas oo aad u isticmaasho 반말.
n-k-k4-05.thinking.2: Ogaanshaha erayada heerka hadalka ee kala duwan
n-k-k4-05.prereq.2: Wuu la kulmay 드세요 iyo 할머니
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri fariimaha hal weedh hal mar oo hubi sida weedh kasta u dhammaato.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi fal loo isticmaalay casho 할머니 iyo dhammaadyada.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.a: Labada weedhoodba waxay ku dhammaadaan sida aad ula hadlayso saaxiib ama qof ka yar, ma aha 할머니.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.c: Weedhda koowaad waxay u dhacdaa hadal aan rasmi ahayn (올게); labada weedh isma mid aha.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.d: Waa edeb leh, laakiin 먹어요 ma sharfo 할머니 sida 드세요 u sameeyo cuntadeeda.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.explain: Ku wajahan 할머니 weedh kasta waxay u baahan tahay -요 ama dhammaad ixtiraam leh, cuntadeedana waxay qaadataa fal ixtiraam leh 드세요. Dhammaadyada aan rasmi ahayn (가, 먹어, 올게) waa saaxiibbo iyo dadka ka yar, isku darka heerarka hal qoraal ahna wuxuu u dhawaaqaa dayac.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.prompt: Qor qoraalkaaga 할머니 af Kuuriyaan. Dheh guriga waxaad joogi doontaa 7:00 iyo sababta.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow ku wicida 할머니, kadibna sheeg waqtiga iyo sababta.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ku hadlay 할머니 oo weedh kasta si edeb leh ku dhammeeyay?
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma warka (7:00 iyo sababta) dhammaantiis way jiraan?
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.modelNote.0: Edeb leh, sabab, waqti iyo khad daryeel ah.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Aad u gaaban, weli edeb leh.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.prompt: Hadda qor fariinta walaalkaa yar (동생), adigoo isticmaalaya 반말. Sheeg isla warka: guriga waxaad joogi doontaa 7:00. Ku dar hal wax oo aad rabto inuu sameeyo.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.0: Dheh isla waqtiga, laakiin isticmaal dhammaadyada aad la isticmaasho 동생.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ku dar hal codsi oo gaaban (먹어, 해 줘, 기다려 ...).
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma dhammaadyadayda oo dhan waa kuwo aan rasmi ahayn?
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma wuxuu qaadayaa isla warka qoraalka 할머니?
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.modelNote.0: Isla war, aan rasmi ahayn, codsi leh.
